repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库逆向工程整理了30余款主流AI编程工具的系统提示词与内部机制，涵盖Cursor、Claude Code、Devin AI、Windsurf等核心产品。提供超过30,000行真实配置，为开发者、安全研究员和架构师提供罕见的AI代理架构底层洞察，适用于提示词工程优化、竞品分析和AI安全研究。
repos.summary_en: This repository reverse-engineers and aggregates system prompts and internal mechanisms from 30+ mainstream AI coding tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Devin AI, and Windsurf. With over 30,000 lines of actual configurations, it offers unprecedented insights into AI agent architectures for prompt engineering optimization, competitive analysis, and AI security research.

repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是开源的 CapCut 替代品，提供 Web、桌面和移动端视频编辑。基于 Next.js 和 React 构建，采用 Zustand 状态管理与 TypeScript 类型安全。支持时间线多轨道编辑和实时预览，核心优势是隐私优先（视频本地处理）、无订阅费用和水印，为商业闭源编辑器提供强大替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source alternative to CapCut that provides comprehensive video editing capabilities for web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Built on Next.js and React with Zustand state management, it delivers timeline-based multi-track editing with real-time preview. The project emphasizes privacy by processing videos entirely on-device, eliminating subscriptions and watermarks. Leveraging TypeScript, Bun, and Docker, OpenCut offers a streamlined development experience and a robust, privacy-first substitute for commercial video editing solutions.

repos.description: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
repos.summary_zh: PicGo是专为创作者设计的终极图片上传工具，无缝集成Obsidian、VS Code、Typora等主流编辑器。支持60+图床服务（GitHub、阿里云OSS、S3等），通过拖拽/粘贴/快捷键实现秒传并自动复制链接。独创插件系统可扩展支持Cloudflare R2等新兴存储，彻底消除写作中的上下文切换，让创作者专注内容生产。
repos.summary_en: PicGo is the ultimate image uploader for efficient creators, seamlessly integrating with Obsidian, VS Code, Typora and other editors. Supporting 60+ image hosts (GitHub, Alibaba Cloud OSS, AWS S3), it enables instant uploads via drag-and-drop/clipboard/hotkeys with auto-copied links. Its extensible plugin system adds support for Cloudflare R2 and more, eliminating context switching to maximize creative focus.

repos.description: 解决Cursor在免费订阅期间出现以下提示的问题:  Your request has been blocked as our system has detected suspicious activity / You've reached your trial request limit.  /  Too many free trial accounts used on this machine.
repos.summary_zh: go-cursor-help是一款用于重置Cursor AI IDE免费试用状态的工具，专门解决因系统检测异常活动、达到试用请求限制或设备关联过多试用账号而导致的阻断问题。通过自动化机制绕过Cursor的试用验证，使开发者能够持续使用AI编程功能。该仓库同时提供付费Cursor Pro账号及7天通行证等订阅服务，形成工具+账号的完整解决方案。
repos.summary_en: go-cursor-help is a tool designed to reset the free trial status of Cursor AI IDE, specifically addressing block issues caused by suspicious activity detection, trial request limits, or excessive trial accounts on a single machine. It automates bypassing Cursor's trial verification, enabling developers to continuously access AI programming features. The repository also offers paid Cursor Pro accounts and 7-day passes, providing a complete tool-and-account solution.

repos.description: Open-source 3D architecture software for AECO, scan-to-BIM. Agent-friendly, browser-first, MCP, CLI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Web 的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供浏览器内专业级 BIM 编辑能力。采用 React Three Fiber + WebGPU 实现高性能渲染，Turborepo  monorepo 架构分离核心逻辑与渲染层，Zustand 分层状态管理配合 IndexedDB 持久化与 Zundo 撤销重做，支持建筑模型的节点化数据管理与实时空间查询。
repos.summary_en: A web-based 3D building editor delivering professional BIM capabilities in-browser. Built on React Three Fiber + WebGPU for high-performance rendering, Turborepo monorepo architecture separates core logic from rendering, with layered Zustand state management, IndexedDB persistence, and Zundo undo/redo. Enables node-based building data management and real-time spatial queries.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: RooCode是VS Code扩展，提供多模式AI开发团队。支持代码生成、架构设计、调试、文档编写等全流程任务，集成MCP服务器实现工具扩展，通过自然语言指令驱动AI代理完成编程工作。
repos.summary_en: RooCode is a VS Code extension that embeds a complete AI-powered development team directly in your code editor. It provides specialized modes including Code for everyday tasks, Architect for system design, Ask for explanations, Debug for issue tracing, and customizable modes for team workflows. The extension integrates with MCP servers for extensible tooling and enables natural language-driven code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation writing, and task automation.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款轻量级(25MB)跨平台Markdown笔记应用，深度融合AI智能能力，原生支持RAG检索增强与MCP协议，能够智能桥接碎片化记录与结构化写作，实现知识高效组织与管理。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight (25MB) cross-platform Markdown note app with AI, RAG and MCP support for intelligent knowledge organization.

repos.description: The open source AI video agent: turns any coding agent into a video agent, with editors to change anything it makes.
repos.summary_zh: OpenFilm是开源AI视频智能体，可将任意编码智能体转化为视频制作工具。它以单个HTML文件为核心，通过frame(t)函数驱动浏览器渲染每一帧，配合Studio编辑器支持手动或对话式修改视频元素，实现从生成到精剪的完整视频创作流程。
repos.summary_en: OpenFilm is an open-source AI video agent that turns any coding agent into a video maker. Using a single HTML file with a frame(t) function, it renders each frame in the browser via WebGL, canvas, SVG, or CSS. The Studio editor lets you manually or conversationally refine every element, trim clips on the timeline, and render MP4s—enabling end-to-end video creation without frameworks like Remotion. It works with Codex, Claude Code, and other agents.

repos.description: A vector graphics application for structured SVG editing, available on all major desktop platforms and on web. Currently in late alpha.
repos.summary_zh: GodSVG 是一款结构化 SVG 编辑器，直接操作 SVG 源码而非添加元数据，实现 UI 与代码实时双向同步。生成干净、精确、优化的矢量文件，适合设计师与开发者对图形进行像素级控制。支持桌面与 Web 平台，目前处于晚期 alpha 阶段，强调低抽象工作流。
repos.summary_en: GodSVG is a structured SVG editor that fundamentally differs from traditional tools by directly manipulating SVG source code without metadata overhead. It enables real-time bidirectional sync between visual editing and code view, producing clean, precise, and highly optimized vector files. Designed for designers and developers requiring pixel-perfect control, it runs on desktop and web platforms in late alpha stage.

repos.description: 🌩️ Serverless 自托管的文件管理与文本分享工具/网盘，支持多存储聚合管理和WebDAV 服务挂载。兼容 S3、WebDAV、OneDrive、Google Drive、Telegram、HF、GitHub 等。内置   Markdown 编辑器、30+文件格式预览。支持 Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker 部署。
repos.summary_zh: CloudPaste 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Serverless 自托管网盘，核心价值在于多云存储聚合管理与零运维部署。支持 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive 等 30+ 存储后端，提供统一 WebDAV 挂载。内置 Vditor Markdown 编辑器与 30+ 文件格式预览，实现个人知识库管理与团队协作。通过边缘计算实现全球加速，Docker 部署提供本地灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CloudPaste is a Serverless self-hosted cloud storage built on Cloudflare Workers, aggregating 30+ storage backends including S3, OneDrive, and Google Drive with unified WebDAV mounting. It features a Vditor Markdown editor, 30+ file format previews, and edge computing acceleration across 300+ global nodes. Offering zero-maintenance deployment via Workers or Docker, it serves as an ideal solution for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Digital Garden 插件将 Obsidian 知识库转化为精美数字花园网站。支持选择性发布（仅 dg-publish: true 笔记公开），保护隐私。全面兼容 Dataview、Canvas、Excalidraw、Mermaid 等功能，提供搜索、图谱、反向链接导航及主题/CSS 定制。基于 Eleventy 静态生成，通过 Vercel/Netlify 一键部署或 Forestry 托管，实现零成本、完全可控的知识分享与持续迭代。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Digital Garden plugin transforms Obsidian vaults into beautiful, customizable digital garden websites. It enables selective publishing via 'dg-publish: true' frontmatter for privacy control. It supports extensive Obsidian features including Dataview queries, Canvas, Excalidraw, Mermaid diagrams, plus advanced navigation like search, graphs, and backlinks. Customization includes themes, CSS variables, and custom components. Powered by Eleventy for static sites, it offers seamless deployment to Vercel/Netlify or managed hosting via Forestry.md, giving users full ownership of their evolving knowledge base.

repos.summary_zh: Isoflow 是基于 React 的开源网络图绘制组件，提供拖放编辑器、可扩展图标系统（支持 AWS/Azure 等云插件）和代码/图片导出功能。作为 MIT 许可的开源核心项目，社区版适用于 IT 基础设施可视化、云架构设计与网络拓扑规划场景。技术亮点在于灵活的插件机制与 React 组件的易集成性，助力快速构建专业网络文档。
repos.summary_en: Isoflow is an open-source React component for drawing network diagrams. It features a drag-and-drop editor, extensible icon system with plugins for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and export options to code or images. As an MIT-licensed open-core project, the Community Edition is ideal for architecture visualization, infrastructure planning, and network topology scenarios. Highlights include plugin extensibility and seamless React integration.

repos.description: 一款功能强大的 Nginx 配置文件可视化编辑工具
repos.summary_zh: nginx-flow 是一款基于 React Flow 的 Nginx 配置可视化编辑器，通过拖拽式画布构建 server/location/upstream 节点，实现配置即编程。内置生产级模板库覆盖 SPA、反向代理、负载均衡等场景，集成智能体检引擎可自动检测安全风险与性能问题并提供一键修复，支持实时配置预览与流量模拟，显著提升运维效率与配置准确性。
repos.summary_en: nginx-flow is a visual Nginx config editor built on React Flow, transforming manual configuration into drag-and-drop canvas programming with server/location/upstream nodes. It features production-ready templates for SPA, reverse proxy, load balancing, and smart audit engine that auto-detects security risks and performance issues with one-click fixes. Real-time config preview, traffic simulation, and bilingual support streamline DevOps workflows, reducing errors and accelerating deployment.

repos.description: LinPad — Linux for iPad. A real Linux desktop on the iPad: native windowed desktop with tiling and workspaces, real Linux apps (Firefox, VS Code, Thunar, VLC) as native windows, ARM64 JIT, GPU via Venus/Metal, keyboard + trackpad + touch.
repos.summary_zh: LinPad 将 iPad 变身真实 Linux 桌面，基于 Alpine Linux 与 Wayland 合成器，原生运行 VS Code、Firefox、VLC 等应用，支持窗口平铺、工作区、ARM64 JIT 及 Venus/Metal GPU 加速，无需虚拟机或越狱，一个应用解锁 iPad 完整生产力。
repos.summary_en: LinPad transforms iPad into a real Linux desktop powered by Alpine Linux and Wayland, running native apps like VS Code, Firefox, and VLC with window tiling, workspaces, ARM64 JIT, and Venus/Metal GPU acceleration—no VM or jailbreak needed.

repos.description: Markdown editor that gets out of your way. Lightweight, fast, portable. First release of https://4worlds.dev
repos.summary_zh: Inkwell是基于Rust+Tauri v2构建的轻量级Markdown编辑器，主打离线运行与极速启动（<1秒）。支持Mermaid图表、LaTeX公式、GitHub Flavored Markdown，提供4种主题与专注模式。100%本地存储，零遥测，安装包仅5-12MB。适用于跨平台写作，免费版功能完整，Pro版解锁PDF/HTML导出。
repos.summary_en: Inkwell is a sovereign Markdown editor built with Rust+Tauri v2, delivering <1s startup and offline-first operation. Features Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, GitHub Flavored Markdown, 4 themes, focus mode, and version history. 100% local storage, zero telemetry, 5-12MB footprint. Cross-platform for distraction-free writing. Free forever, Pro adds PDF/HTML export.
